title: Pyne Pod Pomegranate Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Pomegranate Ice 10ml E-Liquid delivers a brilliantly sharp and cooling fruit experience. The profile highlights the unique, ruby-rich tartness of Pomegranate, which provides an exotic and deeply refreshing inhale. To ensure a clean and frosty finish, a brisk layer of Ice follows on the exhale, contrasting the bold fruit notes and leaving the palate feeling thoroughly invigorated and refreshed. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the exotic chill of Pomegranate Ice, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the balanced Strawberry Kiwi Ice, the tangy Lemon Lime, or the vibrant Summer Punch.
